text.en: Some people walk where there is no path and make a highway for others.

This prose lesson by Kamalalayan says that people come into history and some become history itself. They make a single-footed path where none existed and turn it into a highway. The lesson then speaks of how education changes lives.
It encourages us to have new hope through education and effort. Even one person can open a way for many.
Terms: நம்பிக்கை (hope), வரலாறு (history), பாதை (path) and கல்வி.
